description: Implement the control-plane data-model records from the design and establish the storage split: human-readable files-on-disk for exportable state (project tree, memory, skills) vs out-of-tree control-plane metadata (project registry, share links, connector bindings, secret values) so secrets never enter an exported tree. Covers spec task 3.1 (Wave 0). Depends on FEAT-001 (enums + harness).
steps: Create record factory/validator modules under src/model/ for each data model in design.md's Data Models section, using the enums from src/model/enums.js: User_Account (id, authIdentity, createdAt), Authorization (userAccountId, resourceType, resourceId, relation), Project (id, ownerId, description, targetCategory, origin, originRef?, targets, sandboxId, snapshots, connectors, provider, model, createdAt, updatedAt), Target (kind, rootPath, devServer?, lastArtifact?), Snapshot (id, projectId, parentId?, createdAt, trigger), Connector (service, category, captureKind), ConnectorBinding (connector, secretRefs (names only), status), Secret (projectId, name, ciphertext, wrappedDataKey - VALUES OUT-OF-TREE, never in exportable state), Skill (name, invocationName, description, body, kind, ownerId?, path), MemoryEntry (id, scope, kind, text, createdAt, origin), MemoryStoreMeta (scope, mode default 'auto', capBytes default 65536, capEntries default 200), DeploymentArtifact (targetKind, path, exitStatus), ShareLink (token, projectId, access 'read-only', createdAt, expiresAt, revoked), VerifyResult (verdict, exitCode, failureLines, outputTail). Each model: a create/normalize function that validates required fields and enum membership (reuse enums.js predicates) and returns a plain object; reject invalid enum values with a clear error. Prefer a shared src/model/index.js barrel. Keep records as plain serializable data (no classes required).

Implement the storage-split abstraction (e.g. src/storage/layout.js and/or src/storage/store.js) defining two clearly separated location kinds WITHOUT wiring real persistence beyond what is testable on disk: (1) EXPORTABLE, files-on-disk, human-readable state that lives inside a Project tree - project source files, memory (human-readable), skills (SKILL.md); (2) CONTROL-PLANE, out-of-tree metadata that must never enter an exported tree - project registry, share links, connector bindings, and secret values. Provide path helpers: an exportable project-tree path per project, and an out-of-tree control-plane path per owner/project. Make the invariant explicit in code + comments: secret values and control-plane metadata resolve to paths OUTSIDE any project's exportable tree. Control-plane records are keyed/filterable by ownerId (three-axis isolation, Req 7.6).

Add test/model.test.js (node --test): each model factory accepts a valid record and rejects invalid enum values (e.g. bad targetCategory/origin/category/memory mode) with an error; MemoryStoreMeta defaults mode='auto', capBytes=65536, capEntries=200; ConnectorBinding.secretRefs holds names only (no values); Secret record carries ciphertext/wrappedDataKey and NO plaintext value field.

Add test/storage.test.js (node --test): assert the storage split invariant - given a projectId/ownerId, the exportable project-tree path and the out-of-tree control-plane/secret path do not overlap (the control-plane path is not a descendant of the exportable tree), so a secret value's storage location can never fall inside an exported project tree. Cover project-registry, share-link, connector-binding, and secret locations.
acceptance_criteria: src/model/ exports validated factories for all 14 data models named in design.md, using the enums from src/model/enums.js.
Model factories reject invalid enum values with a clear error and accept valid records.
MemoryStoreMeta defaults are mode 'auto', capBytes 65536, capEntries 200.
The Secret model stores ciphertext + wrappedDataKey and never a plaintext value field; ConnectorBinding holds secret names only.
The storage-split layer resolves control-plane/secret paths that are provably outside any exportable project tree, and this is asserted by a test.
cd /projects/sandbox/ai-app-builder && npm test passes all files (real counts, exit 0).
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/ai-app-builder && npm test  (confirm test/model.test.js and test/storage.test.js pass with real counts)
findings: Implemented all 14 data-model record factories in src/model/ (account.js, project.js, connector.js, skill.js, memory.js, deployment.js) plus a shared validate.js helper and an index.js barrel that also re-exports enums.js. Each createX factory validates required fields + enum membership (reusing enums.js isValidX predicates where the enum lives there; local frozen literal sets for design-only enums such as resourceType/relation/captureKind/trigger/verdict/access/skill-kind/memory-kind) and returns a plain serializable object. Storage split lives in src/storage/layout.js: createStorageLayout(baseDir) yields sibling exportRoot (EXPORTABLE: project tree, .memory, .skills) and controlRoot (CONTROL-PLANE: project registry, share-links, connector-bindings, secrets), all control-plane paths keyed by ownerId. isInsideExportTree()/assertOutsideExportTrees() prove the no-overlap invariant. Key invariants enforced and tested: Secret factory rejects any plaintext `value` field and stores only ciphertext+wrappedDataKey; ConnectorBinding.secretRefs are non-empty strings (names) only; MemoryStoreMeta defaults mode='auto'/capBytes=65536/capEntries=200; secret/control-plane paths provably resolve outside every exportable project tree; id path-segments reject traversal/separators. No real encryption implemented (deferred to task 12.4 per plan) - only path layout + no-overlap guarantee, both real and tested. Verification: `npm test` => 26/26 pass, exit 0 (harness 5, model 14, storage 7). Stayed on branch feat/platform-wave0-wave1; plumby untouched.
